inputs.name: exports
inputs.description: Exports, by path, such as { "/srv/nfs/media" = { clients = [{ host = "192.168.1.0/24", options = ["rw"] }] } }. The circuit creates each path with owner, group and mode.

inputs.name: nfs_v3
inputs.description: Serve NFSv3 as well as NFSv4. Off, the server speaks NFSv4 only and needs just TCP 2049. Changing it restarts the NFS server.
